name: Leeuwenhoek’s reported microscopic life
description: Antoni van Leeuwenhoek reported minute living organisms seen through a microscope, and corroborating papers were read to the Royal Society.

impact.note: Naturalists learned that unseen living organisms exist, a new piece of knowledge from which the study of microscopic life eventually grew.

date.basis: Date of the cited publication or documented episode; not a claim that the underlying work began that year.

events.statement: The Royal Society recorded reading corroborating papers about Leeuwenhoek’s earlier observations in 1677.
events.scope: Antoni van Leeuwenhoek reported minute living organisms seen through a microscope, and corroborating papers were read to the Royal Society.
events.caveats: The 1677 meeting is a dated record, not a first-observation date or a taxonomic identification of each reported organism.
